# ViraStack Mask

> Zero-config input masks for React Hook Form, with Turkish validators, type safety and server support. npm: `@virastack/mask` (2.x). Zero runtime dependencies, ~8 KB.

Install: `npm install @virastack/mask`. Peers: `react` ≥ 18.2, `react-hook-form` ≥ 7.55. The form stores the **raw** value (`5551234567`); the input shows the mask (`(555) 123 45 67`). Spread the returned object onto the input as is.

For inline API + examples, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/mask/llms-full.txt). v1 docs are archived at [v1/llms.txt](https://virastack.com/mask/v1/llms.txt).

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://virastack.com/mask/docs): Install, peers, comparison with imask and Maskito
- [Upgrade from v1](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/upgrade): Signature, presets, options and helpers that changed
- [useViraMask()](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/use-vira-mask): Schema, linked fields (`from`), return props, React Hook Form compatibility
- [Custom mask](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/custom-mask): Pattern syntax, tokens, optional and fixed parts, dynamic masks, number/currency/date, `definePreset`
- [Validation](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/validation): Error keys, custom validators, `maskResolver` for Zod/Valibot
- [Server](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/server): `@virastack/mask/server`, `parseMasked`, Standard Schema
- [Helpers](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/helpers): `createMask`, validators, `toMinorUnits`
- [Types](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/types): `PresetName`, `MaskOptions`, schema and field types
- [UI libraries](https://virastack.com/mask/docs/ui-libraries): shadcn/ui, Ant Design, Chakra
- [Examples](https://virastack.com/mask/examples): Live preset index

## Notable examples

- [Credit card form](https://virastack.com/mask/examples/credit-card): Card + expiry + CVV linked with `from`
- [Phone](https://virastack.com/mask/examples/phone): E.164; `{ preset: "phone", country: "TR" }` for `(555) 123 45 67` (type +90, 0 or 555), raw 10 digits
- [IBAN](https://virastack.com/mask/examples/iban): every country, mod-97 and country length; `{ preset: "iban", country: "TR" }` writes `TR` for you
- [TCKN](https://virastack.com/mask/examples/tckn): Turkish national ID
- [Currency](https://virastack.com/mask/examples/currency): Intl formatting, `{ preset: "currency", country: "TR" }` for `₺1.234,56`, follows a currency select
- [Date](https://virastack.com/mask/examples/date): ISO value, min/max, minAge, start/end
- [Custom mask](https://virastack.com/mask/examples/custom): `definePreset` plate example
